title: Reconsideration notices an old formula’s pull

captions.physics: Ending an exhausted explanation of advice
captions.emotions: Feeling held by an attractive answer

meaning: Reconsidering experience can let your shared view end an old explanation while noticing the attraction of an answer that promised too much.
text: An attractive answer can hold attention after its explanatory role ends. Death in the physical position of Ajna ends an exhausted formula about advice. Judgement in energy returns experience for substantial reconsideration. The Devil in emotions feels held by a convenient answer. Your view can acknowledge that pull and distinguish again what the advice actually clarified, allowing an old approach to retain a particular contribution without becoming the only explanation of success.

For example, you revisit a note saying every text needs a short plan. You previously explained a successful letter solely through having one. Other examples reveal words and transitions mattering too. **Reconsideration lets a formula end while keeping attachment visible.** One technique stops explaining the entire result. The old answer’s simplicity still appeals. Your view can recognise that feeling and examine structure’s particular contribution separately. A plan retains significance while other textual features gain foundations without another single secret being needed immediately.

The risk is treating a wish to recover simplicity as proof of the technique’s exceptional power. Reconsideration selects only successful confirmations. Returning to experience preserves different examples. A plan clarifies connections in some while others require another explanation. Understanding remains free when an ended formula need not return for pleasure and attraction to a familiar answer allows substantial questions about its actual area of usefulness.
